item.title: Cyprus RAF base tells Brits to take cover as explosions heard
item.description: A "security threat" was declared at the British bases in Cyprus shortly before midnight on Sunday, with personnel told to "return to your homes and stay inside until further notice"
item.author: Laura Hill

media:content.media:description: AKROTIRI, CYPRUS - FEBRUARY 3: In this handout image provided by the UK Ministry of Defence, a Royal Air Force Typhoon FRG4s is being prepared to conduct further strikes against Houthi military targets in Yemen at RAF Akrotiri on February 3, 2024 in Akrotiri, Cyprus. RAF Typhoon aircraft have conducted a further set of strikes against Houthi military facilities in Yemen involved in their attacks against international shipping in the Red Sea. (Photo by Cpl Samantha Drummee/MoD Crown Copyright via Getty Images)
